accepted_scope: Original run_pilot target was built in-memory after model loading, and was not a dependency in _PilotReconciliationPass or _DependencyForest during numerical reconciliation. A prepared immutable value can replace it without adding huge file witnesses to every refresh.

Independent CPU reconstruction+unchanged _validate_inventory+exact root-anchored payload/descriptor/source/input identity authenticates deterministic DATA. CPU validation flags or self-signed completion alone do not. Existing root pilot admission kind and mapping anchoring can bind extra preparation fields because native admission hash covers the whole body; no new authority kind is needed.

Fresh model_guard remains before authenticated reader, after its costly work immediately before original loader, and after actual post-load geometry. Every original live/numeric/per-operation witness, control, selected backing check and deadline remains; new handle must carry no execution proof.

CPU selected target must wait for actual complete selection; no invented selection or early selected admission. Downstream _authenticated_pilot_receipts independent reconstruction and completed original source/admission/cost checks stay.

Explicit root/independent acceptance of the new data-authentication seam is required as a source design change. Original code does not require a new per-refresh transport-file witness; requiring one would be a new stronger contract. No inherent need for a new cap or policy bypass is established.
decision: REVISE; phase-scoped transport is contract-compatible in principle, not implementation or admission acceptance
feasibility: UNRESOLVED. Genuine fit-select payload is 11421127399 bytes. All in-allocation reads/hash/parse/freeze/final scans, original guards, both model startups, controls/forwards/serialization/reconciliation and both finish reserves must fit paired1800 seconds and actual memory/storage. Selected target size/receiver behavior are unmeasured; remove-builder alone does not establish .5GPUh feasibility. No GPU recommendation until measured conservative paired bound exists.

findings.finding: Final backing barrier placement is underspecified. Original target conflict/origin happens BEFORE expensive complete guard-union measurement and reconciliation.before_publication. A new check only there cannot support the promised reject-on-late-replacement rule.
findings.minimal_correction: Fresh exact descriptor+target references and lexical path policy immediately after those costly steps and before _publish_measured_pilot_receipt; retain final live guard/deadline after costly checks. Bind the authenticated entry references in origin and intake. Do not accept a new current reference at final as replacement for entry identity.
tests: Replace backing during guard-union timing; final publication must not run.
Replace descriptor/marker/payload at the same canonical path with same size/restored mtime; final barrier rejects.
Shorten/expire allocation during final hash; final live deadline rejects.

findings.finding: Existing object_reference is a content reference, not a lexical tree/inode witness. _complete rejects child symlinks but root/ancestor aliases can resolve elsewhere; a byte-identical replaced root can leave reference equal. Design says reject symlink/path substitution without specifying expected alias semantics.
findings.minimal_correction: Pin allowed canonical lexical path, exact root-bound resolved reference and literal allowed alias chain at entry/final; use a phase-only _FileWitness/tree identity if claiming replacement detection, or explicitly narrow the claim to exact content+approved resolution. Do not insert this transport witness into numeric per-operation refresh sets.
tests: Substitute root/ancestor symlink to different tree, including byte-identical tree; assert explicit chosen path policy.
Extra directory/file, leaf symlink, incomplete marker and marker-only resign reject.

findings.finding: Same-buffer hash is necessary but does not make the surrounding scans cheap. object_reference calls _complete (one full child hash) then hashes each file again. read_object adds completion hashing plus parse/read. _finish hashes children twice then _complete hashes again. Literal composition can scan the whole payload repeatedly at entry/final.
findings.minimal_correction: Specify exact receiver sequence and measure real full-payload read/hash counts, parse, freeze, reference checks, validation, guard time and peaks. A specialized same-buffer strict reader may combine checks against root-pinned payload+marker bytes, retaining exact completion and child-set semantics, but must not replace an existing numeric witness or use cached file stat as content proof. Any optimized reader needs differential/rejection review.
tests: Instrument reads/hash calls on a small exact-format fixture; compare authenticated reference and parsed value to original artifact contract.
Transient rewrite produces a hash mismatch for the same buffer parsed; altered bytes never hide behind separate parse/hash reads.
Nonfinite or structurally invalid JSON and wrong part/source/input bindings reject before loader.

findings.finding: JSON destroys builder sharing. Parsed strings/dicts/lists and frozen copies may coexist with raw bytes; large metadata retention is not bounded by producer peak. The exact frozen requirement objects, not reconstructed equal dicts, must be given to reconciliation.
findings.minimal_correction: Bind receiver cost record to exact bytes/source/environment and chosen reader/freeze implementation. Account raw/decode/freeze overlap plus retained target, pilot authority proof, model staging, numeric proofs and full original tiers without subtracting unmeasured shared memory. Pass one handle graph and its requirement identities, retaining distinct timing-record semantics; reject reinitialization/cross-PID/part/context misuse.
tests: One handle graph supplies reconciliation requirement IDs; equal-value copied requirements reject.
Mutating or replacing handle/value/reference or reinitializing handle rejects; fork/pickle/wrong PID rejects.
Distinct retained timing records remain independent, dummy/source semantics and exact serialized bytes match; no interning/coalescing.
Understated bound, wrong receiver measurement/environment or insufficient actual allocation rejects before model load.

preserved: original runtime and all existing guard/witness behavior
all caps and original source admission gates
